scope: Paper game printed Stratagems; trigger timing vs post-Pass Opening Orders
resolution_model: After Pass and both closing turns: order reveal and any opening-reveal Stratagems; Commit payments; paired numbered Maneuvers with move triggers; paired numbered Strikes with Attack triggers; final single resolution Stratagem reveal; Front scoring.
rules: All four Opening Orders revealed at once, before triggered card responses.
Opening order redirection changes only an existing chosen Maneuver destination, not source, action kind or order count.
When simultaneous Strikes are legal at a numbered step, applying an affliction from one cannot undo the other Strike's legality retroactively.
An Archer counterattack uses its ordinary unused Attack allowance; a later Strike with the same Force fails.
Final resolution Stratagem eligibility uses the post-Opening-Orders provisional state, and a new tie caused by revealed effects does not open another reveal.

stratagems.trigger: Immediately after both players reveal their two Opening Orders; before Commit payments
stratagems.effect: Scout or Seer here; redirect destination of one own existing Maneuver starting here
stratagems.distinct: No additional Move/Attack; no viewing opponent face-down Stratagem; different from Rider extra-Move reaction

stratagems.trigger: When enemy Tactic targets formation OR before affliction from an opposing Opening Strike or ordinary Attack
stratagems.effect: Ignore Tactic effect or prevent one Attack affliction
stratagems.distinct: Defense only, not extra movement or Attack
stratagems.watch: Works during Strike and ordinary turns

stratagems.trigger: After a Rider moves into/out of the assigned Front, including an Opening Maneuver
stratagems.effect: One further adjacent legal Move and +1 temporary Rider Strength
stratagems.distinct: Triggered Rider-only extension with +Strength; differs from public Bonded opening-only extension

stratagems.trigger: When friendly formation here becomes Named, possibly by an Opening Move into prepared components
stratagems.effect: Two-step legal Move or bounce opposing attached Bond
stratagems.distinct: Formation-completion interruption; not another Opening Order

stratagems.trigger: After friendly Raider/Skirmisher inflicts negative marker, including through Opening Strike
stratagems.distinct: Attachment disruption, not another Attack or a general anti-Move effect

stratagems.trigger: After opposing Force Attacks here; Opening Strike also counts
stratagems.effect: One unused basic Archer counterattack, marks that Attack spent
stratagems.distinct: Counterattack uses existing once-per-Battle use; not the same as initial Opening Strike
stratagems.watch: No retroactive cancellation of simultaneous Strike

stratagems.trigger: One final resolution reveal, after all Opening Orders and after provisional totals are known
stratagems.effect: Break initial tie if still tied, or apply +2 on initial one-point deficit with unique Named advantage
stratagems.distinct: Conditional tie manipulation, not +2 Opening Commit or early reaction

stratagems.trigger: One final resolution reveal, after Opening Orders
stratagems.effect: Move one friendly formation; +2 temporary Strength only if moved
stratagems.distinct: Late generic mobility, unlike early Maneuver that opens Strike targets
stratagems.watch: Partial Move/+2 overlap with two other resolution plans; watch

stratagems.trigger: One final resolution reveal, after Opening Orders
stratagems.effect: At final resolution, if a King or Captain here, exchange one friendly formation here with one in an adjacent active Front in the same rank, if legal
stratagems.distinct: Late two-formation swap across neighboring Fronts, no Strength addition or opening order
stratagems.watch: Legality and meaningful cross-Front score impact

stratagems.trigger: One final resolution reveal, after Opening Orders
stratagems.effect: At resolution in an outer Front, ignore a friendly flanked Frontline Force's flank penalty and give it +2 Strength
stratagems.distinct: Conditional outer Front counterflank; no movement or ordinary Commit
stratagems.watch: Flanked outer Frontline eligibility after Opening Orders

stratagems.trigger: One final resolution reveal, after Opening Orders
stratagems.effect: King/Captain empowers up to three Humans across this and adjacent Front
stratagems.distinct: Wider cross-Front temporary Strength; no movement
stratagems.watch: Mass buff and uncapped full-margin loss: monitor, distinct from early single-Front Commit
